youtube.title: What if Krampus came to your house?
youtube.description:
Dec 5 is Krampus night in the Alps: Saint Nicholas fills the boots kids leave out – and his horned partner handles the naughty ones. 🔔🎄 Tonight one Krampus stays at your door. It's not wearing a mask.
Krampus is at your door. What do you do? A) Open it B) Hide under the bed C) Clean your room. Fast. – Comment A, B or C 👇
Sources: Wikipedia (Krampus), History.com (The Legend of Krampus)
